notes.title: Игра в стиле Celeste: Обзор Ageless
notes.content: Клоны популярных игр, которые теперь модно называть оммажами, уже давно стали неотъемлемой частью индустрии. Компания One More Dream Studios решила отдать дань уважения одному из самых ярких релизов 2018 года - Celeste.

notes.title: Ageless Patch - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A patch is out now for Ageless with some bug fixes!

[list]
[*] Ageless UI toggles on/off instead of having to hold it down.
[*] Water breathing duration increased by 0.3s.
[*] Lock on now works as intended.
[*] Wobble/Jitter improved on certain controllers.
[*] Lock on now has visual and audio indicators.
[*] Title Music Volume lowered.
[*] Exodus Volume adjusted.
[*] Remnant Bush shot count required to age/de-age reduced from 3 to 2 arrows.
[*] Arms no longer retract instantly on stage transition.
[*] Added grace time to become Ageless more easily after bouncing off Remnant Bush Creature.
[*] Whale mount input now more responsive.
[/list]

We hope these tweaks and changes help you on your journey through the mystical lands of Pandora!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210150/Ageless/

notes.title: Ageless FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Ageless comes out in just a few days!
Want to know more about what you can expect? You’re in the right place![/h1]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36909525/e3dfce3457c5d5703451be157bd8116d9c7c8cbf.png[/img]

[b]What is Ageless?[/b]
Ageless is a story driven puzzle platformer where you must alter the age of animals and plant life around you to progress. Play as Kiara, a young girl who braves through heartache and loss as she journeys across a mysterious world to discovers its secrets and herself.

Ageless was developed by One More Dream Studios!
 

[b]Which platforms is Ageless coming to?[/b]
Ageless will be available on Nintendo Switch & Steam. 

 
[b]Will the game be coming to GOG?[/b]
There are no plans to release Ageless on GOG.


[b]When does Ageless launch?[/b]
Ageless is launching on July 28th 2020

 
[b]Can I buy a boxed copy?[/b]
Ageless is digital only.


 
[b]How much will Ageless cost?[/b]
£10.99 / €14.99 / $14.99

Please check your local Nintendo eShop or Steam for regional prices.

 

[b]Is any DLC available?[/b]
There is no DLC available at launch.

 

[b]Can I remap my keys? On both keyboard and controller?[/b]
You can fully remap your keyboard on PC. There are multiple layout presets for controllers!

 

[b]Is there mouse support?[/b]
Yes, on PC. 

 

[b]Will the game be released for Linux?[/b]
We do not have plans to release Ageless for Linux. 

 
[b]Is there a demo?[/b]
Yes, a free demo is available now on Steam!

 

[b]Will my demo progress carry over into the full game?[/b]
No. Progress is not carried over to the main game.
 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210150/Ageless/

notes.title: Ageless Release Date & Narrative Trailer!
notes.content:
[h3]Get ready to experience an emotional story driven puzzle platformer where you must alter the age of animals and plant life around you to unlock the secrets of mysterious worlds when [b]Ageless comes to Steam on July 28th![/b][/h3]

[b]Check out the new trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=6aZetFc9PeI;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as Kiara, a young girl who braves through heartache and loss as she journeys across a mysterious world to discovers its secrets, and herself.


[b]Become Ageless:[/b] Equipped with a mystical bow, master the art of becoming Ageless. Dash off animals and plant-life to navigate through interesting puzzles and intricate platforming challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36909525/e4ab52c48fa1026a106828510aaf7612abcd4d04.gif[/img]

[b]Unique Aging Mechanic:[/b] Play with the laws of nature to control the age of animals and plants in order to progress through exciting levels.

[b]Not your Average Fairy-tale: [/b] In a tragic story of loss and personal discovery, Kiara must decide if she will use her newfound powers to face her inner demons or run from them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jHcyWkL.gif[/img]

[b]New Worlds to Discover: [/b] Explore new areas filled with unique plants and animals as you progress through the game. Each level is hand-drawn to pixel perfection to create a beautiful world.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gc5ssrb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Ageless!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36909525/92d1d90f43a1518e038216f0e412cc24ef22cfcd.png[/img]Today We’re extremely excited to announce our partnership with Team 17 to bring our story driven puzzle platformer, Ageless, to Steam and Switch later this year.

Follow Kiara as she journeys through a mysterious world in our new announcement trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hPqb973BHGE

[b]Become Ageless: [/b]You wield a  mystical bow which will allow you to control the age of plants and animals. Master the art of becoming Ageless. Dash off animals and plant-life to navigate through interesting puzzles and intricate platforming challenges.

[b]Compelling Story:[/b] How will you utilize Kiara’s newfound powers? Will you face her inner demons or run from them in this story of loss and discovery?

[b]Discover:  [/b]Each area is hand drawn to create this beautiful world and as you explore new areas, you will come across a whole host of unique plants and animals as you progress through the game.

Ageless Comes to Nintendo Switch and Steam later this year.
